# Goyal My Home Sanctuary Mamurdi Pune

> The official knowledge base and real estate intelligence repository for Goyal My Home Sanctuary, a premier 26-acre biophilic nature residential township by Goyal Properties in Mamurdi, Pune West.

## Project Overview
- **Project Name**: Goyal My Home Sanctuary (also known as My Home Sanctuary Mamurdi)
- **Developer**: Goyal Properties (35+ years of legacy, 50+ delivered landmark projects across Pune)
- **Official Website**: https://goyalmyhomesanctuary.in
- **Location**: Survey No. 8(P), Near Mukai Chowk, Kiwale-Mamurdi Road, Mamurdi, Pune West, Maharashtra 412101
- **MahaRERA Registration Number**: PR1261012502725
- **Direct Sales / VIP Desk**: +91 91753 19441
- **Lead Routing Email**: propsmartrealty@gmail.com
- **Land Parcel & Concept**: 26-acre integrated biophilic master plan featuring 72% preserved forest canopy and 1,000+ native trees.
- **Architectural Engineering**: G+28 high-rise residential towers constructed using 100% monolithic aluminum formwork MIVAN concrete engineering.

## Configurations & Pricing (All-Inclusive Estimates)
- **2 BHK Classic**: 638 sq.ft RERA carpet • Starting ₹69 Lakhs*
- **2 BHK Premier**: 704 sq.ft RERA carpet • Starting ₹74 Lakhs*
- **2 BHK Signature**: 760 sq.ft RERA carpet • Starting ₹79 Lakhs*
- **3 BHK Classic**: 848 sq.ft RERA carpet • Starting ₹86 Lakhs*
- **3 BHK Premier**: 924 sq.ft RERA carpet • Starting ₹97 Lakhs*
- **3 BHK Signature (Presidential Sky Suite)**: 1,036 sq.ft RERA carpet • Starting ₹1.05 Cr*

## Connectivity & Proximity
- **Mumbai-Pune Expressway Toll**: 2 minutes (800 meters)
- **Mukai Chowk BRTS Terminal**: 3 minutes
- **Hinjawadi Rajiv Gandhi IT Park (Phases 1, 2 & 3)**: 15 minutes (signal-free arterial commute)
- **Symbiosis Skills & Professional University**: 4 minutes
- **MCA International Cricket Stadium Gahunje**: 4 minutes
- **D-Mart Ravet**: 6 minutes
- **Phoenix Mall of the Millennium Wakad**: 14 minutes
- **Upcoming Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIAL)**: 75 minutes via Expressway

## Curated 75+ Lifestyle Amenities
- 35,000 sq.ft grand clubhouse pavilion ("The Sanctuary Pavilion")
- Semi-Olympic temperature-controlled heated swimming pool with jacuzzi and sun deck
- 1.2 KM vehicle-free central green jogging track & reflexology trail
- Dual professional pickleball courts & full-sized futsal arena
- Open-air Greek amphitheatre & stargazing sky lounge
- Dedicated native avian bird sanctuary corridor & hammock groves
- Professional acoustic podcast/media recording studio
- Sacred on-site Hindu temple complex
